title: Nintendo Style - Funny Music Loop 02
author: PlayOnLoop
notes: Page: 'A cheeky, fun and playful feel-good 8 bit chiptune music for games... bouncy rhythm'. Only the short zip version on OGA; too short (<60 s); full loop is on playonloop.com (not fetched). Attribution to PlayOnLoop required.

title: C64 Happy Loop
author: Emma_MA
notes: Page: 'An upbeat loopable Commodore 64 sounding piece'. Tags: happy, chiptune. Slightly under 60 s. WAV.

title: Funky Sidewalk Antics (Looping)
author: Eric Matyas
notes: Tags: funky, urban, humorous, seamless looping. Short (32 s). Page has a 'NOTE:' block not captured; check it before use. Attribution to Eric Matyas (soundimage.org) per CC-BY 3.0.

title: Chiploop
author: iamoneabe
notes: Page: 'simple little chiptune loop'. Tags: chiptune, VGM, loopable. Plain and short-melody; mood less lively than others. MP3 used (WAV on page is larger).

title: Sunshine Skirmish (Loop)
author: Trevor Lentz
notes: Page: 'quick upbeat little chiptune loop... light battle music or a party background'. NES-style. Battle-leaning tag; OGG used.

title: 8-bit Chiptune - Run Under Fire
author: shiru8bit
notes: Page: 'Looped to the beginning... Made with Mod2PSG2'. Name fits a fast runner. Under 60 s. Zip also has mp3, vgm and psgmod source (extracted in same folder). FLAC used for duration.

title: Funky Chiptune (Looping)
author: Eric Matyas
notes: Page: 'high energy retro-arcade style game. (1:15)'. Tags: arcade, funny, seamless looping. Attribution to Eric Matyas (soundimage.org) per CC-BY 3.0.

title: The Factory (Funky TIC-80 Chiptune)
author: jocolloman
notes: Page: 'A funky chiptune I created in TIC-80'. Tags: loop, chiptune, 120bpm, funk. Loop WAV used (fade WAV on page not downloaded). 120 BPM per tag.

title: Mountain Battle Chiptune
author: Magnesus
notes: Page: 'Simple synth track that should work well for a retro game. It loops.' Battle track, very short (28 s); may need more length. Tags: battle, fantasy.

title: 8bit Upbeat Town
author: Wolfgang_
notes: Tags: village, town, 8-bit, bustling, upbeat. Made with FamiTracker. Under 60 s. Page also lists it in the '8-bit Game Music' collection.

title: Peaceful Town (8-bit loopable)
author: Drakiah
notes: Page: 'A simple little tune made with BeepBox.' Tags: 8bit, chiptune, loopable. Calm; simple melody.

title: Town
author: mla
notes: Page: 'For RPG town background music'. Tags: looping, RPG, town. Not chiptune-tagged; FLAC is 16.9 MB. Listen before use to confirm 8-bit feel.

title: Relaxing Chiptune Music
author: migfus20
notes: Page genre: 'Chiptune, Relaxin''. Tags: relaxing, chiptune, loop, bgm. Calm; fits memory game.

title: [Chiptune] Medieval: The Old Tower Inn
author: RandomMind
notes: Page: 'available in full track and loop versions'; loop WAV used (full track is NES_TheOldTowerInn mp3 on page, not used). Tags: NES, tavern, positive, major. Loop version is short (33 s). Credit appreciated, not required.

title: One Horse Town
author: tcarisland
notes: Page: '8 bit town music inspired by ragtime'. 110 BPM per page. Page loop points: 1:09:81 (middle), 2:19:63 (finished). Playful ragtime feel; WAV used.

title: Nintendo Style - Quirky Music Loop 01
author: PlayOnLoop
notes: Page: 'Quirky and neat little jazzy melody with a swing groove.' Only the short zip version on OGA (16 s, far below 60 s); full loop on playonloop.com (not fetched). Attribution to PlayOnLoop required.

title: Arcade Oddities (Looping)
author: Eric Matyas
notes: Page: 'A strangely quirky little tune... Kind of catchy in a weird way. (:48)'. Tags: quirky, mysterious, funky. Under 60 s. Attribution: 'Arcade Oddities' by Eric Matyas, soundimage.org.

title: forgotten path
author: johndekale
notes: Page: 'A melancholic chiptune loop with an authentic 8-bit/16-bit feel.' Mysterious rather than playful. Under 60 s. OGG used.

title: Underwater chiptunes (track deepersea)
author: Guy G. Gamerson
notes: Page: 'Two tracks I made... Go ahead and use them in any way you like.' Tags: chiptune, retro, underwater. Track 1 of 2 on the page. Mysterious underwater mood. Not listened to; tempo not stated.

title: Underwater chiptunes (track deepsea)
author: Guy G. Gamerson
notes: Track 2 of 2 on the same page (same license). Under 60 s. Not listened to; tempo not stated.
